## Laboratory

This research was conducted at the **Laboratory of Applied Ethology and Animal Welfare (LETA)**, Department of Zootechny and Rural Development, Federal University of Santa Catarina (UFSC), Florianópolis, Brazil.

LETA has a long-standing research focus on cattle welfare in pasture-based systems, Voisin Rational Grazing, and the behavioral ecology of domestic animals.

---

## Study Context

The experiment was conducted at the **Ressacada Experimental Farm (FER–UFSC)**, Florianópolis, Brazil (27°40'25" S; 48°32'30" W), from December 2021 to April 2022.

Animal procedures were approved by the **Ethics Committee on Animal Use (CEUA) of UFSC** under Protocol 857122042.

Funding for this research was provided by **CAPES** (Coordination for the Improvement of Higher Education Personnel, Brazil) through a Master's scholarship awarded to F.S. Pretto.

---

## Citation

Once published, please cite the original paper. In the meantime, this website may be cited as:

> Pretto, F.S., Donadio, J.P., & Pinheiro Machado Filho, L.C. (*in preparation*). Effect of water and shade access on the behavior and thermal comfort of cattle in a pasture system. *Applied Animal Behaviour Science*.
